title: feat(ui): Studio inspector strings (page block, action, dataset, flow node, app nav, widget) move into the studio i18n namespace (#25922 slice S2)
body:

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8PeP4DzppH3b1kDPCjihHVx)_

Part of #25922

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 设计器表里 `engine.inspector` 下页面区块、动作、数据集、流程节点、应用导航、仪表盘组件六组共 520 个键（en 与 zh 各一份）从 app-shell 的私有表搬进 `@object-ui/i18n` 的 `studio` 命名空间，文案一字未改，调用点不动。
- 为什么改：执行 #25922 裁决 6431032267（Q2 = A，6431234244 维持），这是 (M) 的第 2 片（S2），沿用第 1 片 #26593 建好的懒加载命名空间。
- 风险与回滚：与第 1 片相同，zh 用户首次打开这些检查器时标签会先显示英文、zh 分片到达后同一挂载重渲染为中文；回滚即 revert 本 PR，行原样回到 app-shell。
- 先看：`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts` 末尾新加的 S2 段，再看 `previews/__tests__/block-config-i18n.test.ts` 改为同时读两处的抽取器。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm run check:i18n-designer-parity && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/inspectorStrings.studioNamespace-25922.test.ts`，应全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Slice S2 of the (M) item.** Every `engine.inspector.pageBlock.*`, `.action.*`, `.dataset.*`, `.flowNode.*`, `.appNav.*` and `.widget.*` row (520 keys per language, same set and order in `en` and `zh`) leaves `ENGINE_STRINGS_EN` / `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` and is appended to `STUDIO_EN` / `STUDIO_ZH` in `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts`, text byte-for-byte unchanged. The move was done by an AST pass (each property with its leading comment block, multi-line values kept whole); a heading comment marks the S2 section in each catalogue. Three comment blocks sat at the head of a mixed run: two move with the rows they head ("Action default (home) inspector", "Dashboard filter bindings"), one stays (the audit-failure note); the `option.location.global_nav` retirement note follows the pageBlock rows it describes.
- **No runtime change.** `lookupString` already asks the table first and the namespace second (slice 1), so `t` / `tFormat` / `tOptional` and every call site are untouched. No new file, so the console's `i18n-ns-studio-en` / `i18n-ns-studio-zh` chunk groups need no change; the namespace's only non-test importer is still app-shell's `i18n.ts`.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/25922-studio-i18n-inspectors.md`, `@object-ui/i18n` patch.
- ⛔ Untouched: `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, `ui/.github/**`, root `ci.yml` (its `check:i18n-designer-parity` step stays until S7).

## Why

Ruling 6431032267 Q2 = A (upheld by 6431234244): the designer table becomes one lazy `@object-ui/i18n` namespace, moved in slices; S2 is the second row of #26593's slice table.

## Tests

New:

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/inspectorStrings.studioNamespace-25922.test.ts`: per family (six named floors, so one family draining cannot hide behind another), the namespace carries the family in `en` and `zh`, and `t()` answers every key with the namespace's value in `en-US`, `zh-CN` and `de-DE` (a language with no catalogue reads `en`). The oracle is the catalogues read through `loadStudioCatalogue`.

Forced edits (the zh rows these suites assert synchronously now arrive in the lazily fetched chunk, so each makes `zh` resident with a top-level `await loadStudioCatalogue('zh')`; no assertion changed):

- `inspectors/DashboardWidgetInspector.test.tsx`, `inspectors/DatasetDefaultInspector.firstPickKeepsCount-12848.test.tsx`, `inspectors/FlowNodeInspector.renameNode-11827.test.tsx`, `inspectors/PageBlockInspector.colorLabelling.test.tsx`, `inspectors/PageBlockInspector.i18n.test.tsx`, `inspectors/PageBlockInspector.pageHeaderBreadcrumb-11173.test.tsx`, `inspectors/PageBlockInspector.visibleWhen.test.tsx`, `previews/__tests__/block-config.test.ts` (all under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`).
- `previews/__tests__/block-config-i18n.test.ts`: the pageBlock retirement gate (objectui#8368) read its key sets from the app-shell table by line range; it now reads each locale from BOTH homes (table + `STUDIO_EN` / `STUDIO_ZH`, same extractor), skips the namespace catalogues as definition sites in the literal-reader scan, and adds a guard that the homes are non-empty and no key is counted twice. Plus the zh preload.

`zh-base-term.i18n-13131.test.ts` already reads the namespace's whole `zh` catalogue (slice 1), so it covers the moved rows with no edit.

## Acceptance notes

- **Every moved key resolves identically before and after.** One-off measurement (not committed): the 520 + 520 values were read by AST from the base table at `dc9d1ff8`, then compared with `t()` and `tOptional()` on this branch after `zh` is resident, in `en-US`, `en`, `de-DE`, `fr` (against the base `en` value) and `zh-CN`, `zh`, `zh-TW` (against the base `zh` value): 3,640 lookups, 0 differing.
- **Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed by anchor count and blob, restored byte-identical to `HEAD`):
  - `lookupString` without its `?? studioString(key, locale)` arm: the new pin goes red in all six families and the equivalence check reports 3,640 of 3,640 lookups differing.
  - one moved zh row altered (`engine.inspector.widget.kind`): the equivalence check reports exactly 3 differing lookups (`zh-CN`, `zh`, `zh-TW`); the pin stays green, as designed, since its oracle is the catalogue itself.
- **Eager bundle: not re-measured locally.** The namespace's only non-test importer is app-shell's `i18n.ts`, statically, so the moved `en` rows sit behind the same import edge before and after; the `zh` rows stay in the lazy `i18n-ns-studio-zh` chunk. CI's `Build & E2E UI` runs the eager-closure budget on the built console.
- `check:i18n-drift` reads both homes over the range and reports 0 `en` values changed, 0 keys added or removed.

## Verification

All at `18f4d0f6` unless noted.

After the edits the 11 touched or new files: `Test Files 11 passed (11)`, `Tests 163 passed (163)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both tsconfigs each): VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

- ui: `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations): all exit 0. `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: exit 0.
